test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

That is not a solution available (to most people for who email has become necessity.)

options.text: to most people for who email has become a necessity.
for most people to whom email has became necessity.
to most people for whom email has become a necessity.

solution:
The correct answer is "**to most people for whom email has become a necessity.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the bracketed segment, the error is in the use of the word "who" is incorrect.**
 
• We know that, "Who" should be used to refer to the subject of a sentence.
 
 
• Example: Who made this cake?
 
 
 
• Whom should be used to refer to the object of a verb or preposition.
 
 
• Example: Whom do you trust the most?
 
 
 
• **In the given sentence, "people" are the object of the sentence and "whom" will be used to refer them.**
 
• Also, the article "a" will be used before the noun "necessity."
 
• Thus, the phrase in option 4 will replace the given phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Incorrect use of "who" instead of "whom."
 
• Option 2: Incorrect use of "has became" instead of "has become."
